title: Claude Code: AI Supercharges Engineering Productivity #shorts
description: As a mid-career career changer learning to code, you might feel like you only have two hands. But what if AI coding assistants like Claude Code could give you six? Imagine shipping code 3-5 times a day. That's the reality for engineers using these tools. #CareerChange #softwareengineer #coder
